responsibility: Implements tree SSA copy propagation for SSA_NAMEs and simple constants using the generic SSA propagation engine. It tracks copy-of relationships through assignments and PHIs, decides which statements can generate useful copies, preserves points-to and related SSA metadata when propagating names, and finishes by substituting final representatives into GIMPLE and folding the result, making it the dedicated copy-propagation pass distinct from CCP’s richer constant lattice.
